headline: Visayas Grid on Red Alert; Mindanao on Yellow Alert as Power Reserves Tighten
seoTitle: Visayas Red Alert, Mindanao Yellow Alert | FMB News
seoDescription: NGCP placed the Visayas grid on red alert and Mindanao on yellow alert on August 31 as outages and derated plants tighten power reserves.
deck: Available Visayas capacity was reported at 2,059 MW against a projected peak demand of 2,305 MW.
author: FMB News Desk

sections.heading: What happened
paragraphs: NGCP placed the Visayas grid under red alert from 5 p.m. to 10 p.m. Monday, followed by a yellow alert from 10 p.m. to 11 p.m.

The Visayas grid had 2,059 MW of available capacity against projected peak demand of 2,305 MW. Mindanao was placed under yellow alert from 6 p.m. to 9 p.m., with 2,517 MW available against projected peak demand of 2,376 MW.

sections.heading: Context
paragraphs: The grid operator attributed the tight conditions to numerous forced outages and plants operating below full capacity. The Visayas has repeatedly faced red and yellow alerts this month.

sections.heading: Why this matters
paragraphs: A red alert means supply is insufficient to meet demand plus the grid's regulating requirement, raising the possibility of rotational interruptions. A yellow alert means reserves are below the required contingency margin.

sections.heading: What to watch next
paragraphs: Consumers should monitor their local distribution utility for interruption schedules and conservation advisories, especially during evening peak hours.
